materialName: ATEL-47 bright sky-blue fine white stripe shirt simulation
scope: Surface preset for a standalone office shirt; geometry and stripe artwork are not included.

stripeSpec.orientation: vertical, parallel to garment centerline when worn
stripeSpec.application: front and back shirt body panels only; do not extend onto collar, sleeves, cuffs, placket, buttons, or other trim
stripeSpec.status: pending Designer UV and placement mapping

applicationNotes: Apply the linear base color and metallic-roughness values with the glTF 2.0 metallic-roughness workflow.
Wait for a passed shape review and Designer-provided UV/placement mapping before producing a surface GLB.
Preserve approved geometry and UVs; verify stripe direction, spacing, and clean boundaries on front and back under neutral lighting.

source.brief: ATEL-47 owner brief: bright sky-blue office shirt with fine, evenly spaced white vertical stripes.
source.provenance: Artist-authored visualization values derived from the requested appearance; no external texture or measured textile data used.
source.limitations: Cotton-poplin and stripe appearance are visual simulations only and do not certify fiber composition, hand, or manufacturing properties.
